card.name: Start of stenosing, stannous, stellate words
card.fires_on: The piece " st" that begins a rare medical word such as stenosing, stannous or stellate, usually after a comma or "and" in a list. Also "St" before John's wort.

modes.label: Stenosing peptic ulcer
modes.description: " st" starting "stenosing" in antihistamine and anticholinergic caution lists after glaucoma or hypertension.

modes.description: " st" starting "stannous" in technetium labels or "stellate" in nerve block lists.

modes.label: St. John's wort
modes.description: Capital "St" opening St. John's wort in drug interaction tables.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word endings that finish the rare word, rather than any clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires when a rare word like stenosing, stannous or stellate has just begun with "st".
